Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, late 30s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, high ponytail balayage hair — her body is painted in 5 different painting styles at once, each style claiming its own region of her figure. Every style is rendered in one shared palette of crimson red, black and gold, so the whole figure reads as one harmonious composition. Her figure is divided into 5 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 53% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 5 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 10'clock, 12'clock, 4'clock, 6'clock and 8'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 12 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries Van Gogh style swirling thick brushstrokes rendered only in crimson red, black and gold. Region 2 is the wedge between the 12 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries traditional Japanese irezumi tattoo art with peonies, waves and clouds rendered only in crimson red, black and gold. Region 3 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 6 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries Matisse style paper cut-out leaf-like shapes rendered only in crimson red, black and gold. Region 4 is the wedge between the 6 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries Lichtenstein style Ben-Day dots and thick outlines rendered only in crimson red, black and gold. Region 5 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries thick impasto oil paint with heavy palette-knife ridges rendered only in crimson red, black and gold. Where two regions meet, the two neighbouring paintings blend along the edge: brushwork of one reaches into the other and the two styles simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring paintings, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course, every painting laid on her own living skin and covering her completely from neck to ankle. Her face and ears stay real living skin with visible pores, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a soft natural flush. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, her legs fully in view — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.

Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in burgundy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows tanning oil sheen, golden bronzed glistening skin.

Background: a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
